ContentFellow pricing: every plan in one place

Quick answer: ContentFellow is a UK marketing service based in Burnley, Lancashire. Monthly plans cost £59 to £389: social media from £59, websites £69, SEO + GEO £89, video editing £119, photo and video shoots £149, or everything for £389. Websites cost £349–£1,499 one-off and apps £1,249–£6,499. Every plan has a free trial, no card needed, and no long contract. Prices include everything; no VAT is added. (Updated October 2026.)

Which plan fits which need?

  • Need regular photos and video: Studio Fellow £149 + Creator Fellow £119.
  • Need someone to post on social media: Social Fellow from £59.
  • Need a website: Launch £349 one-off, or Build Fellow £69 a month.
  • Want Google and ChatGPT to recommend you: Search Fellow £89.
  • Want all of it handled: Growth Fellow £389.

Frequently asked questions

How much does ContentFellow cost?

Monthly plans start at £59 (Social Fellow) and go up to £389 for the Growth Fellow, which includes all five services. Websites are £349–£1,499 one-off and apps £1,249–£6,499. Prices include everything; no VAT is added.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. Every Fellow has a free trial with no card needed: 7 days of social media or SEO, a free homepage preview, a free mini shoot or 3 free videos.

Is there a contract?

No long contract. Plans are billed monthly and you can add or remove Fellows from the next month.

Who is ContentFellow for?

UK small businesses, creators and startups that want video, social media, a website, SEO and AI search visibility without agency retainers. Based in Burnley, Lancashire, working across the UK.

Market prices are typical UK ranges from our answers page and price guides, October 2026.
